title: Using Large Language Models for Qualitative Analysis can Introduce Serious Bias
reasoning: The paper specifically evaluates and compares the performance of LLMs in classifying religious and moral aspirations within qualitative interview data. It includes dedicated coding categories and prompts for 'Religious Aspirations', 'Religious Education', and 'Secular Aspirations' (which focuses on character traits and moral values), making the assessment of how LLMs handle religious and ethical concepts a core component of the study.
